methodologyNotes: Roster of 11 consumer/SOHO line-interactive and standby UPS units from APC (Back-UPS, Back-UPS Pro, Smart-UPS), CyberPower (AVR, PFC Sinewave, Intelligent LCD lines), and Tripp Lite/Eaton. Each entry was independently re-verified this session. CyberPower CP1500PFCLCD, CP1350PFCLCD, CP900AVR and CP1500AVRLCD were confirmed spec-by-spec (incl. MSRP) on cyberpowersystems.com official product pages; the Tripp Lite SMART1500LCDT was confirmed field-by-field on Eaton/Tripp Lite's own datasheet PDF (incl. the battery-mode 'PWM sine wave' field, hence simulated_sine); the five APC units were confirmed on apcguard.com authorized-reseller spec pages (BE600M1 also cross-checked on Dell). se.com and most major retailers (B&H, Newegg, Provantage, CDW, Cooper Electric) blocked automated fetching this session. capacity_va/output_watts are nameplate ratings; waveform is pure_sine only where the manufacturer's spec explicitly states true/sine-wave output on battery, simulated_sine for stepped/PWM approximations, null where the battery-mode waveform is not documented; battery_backup_outlets counts only battery-powered outlets (all outlets on the Smart-UPS SMT1500C); avr is true only where AVR is explicitly documented. priceUsd is the clearest sourced USD list/MSRP figure and is nulled rather than guessed when no reliable figure could be confirmed. NOTE: APC prices are authorized-reseller list/MSRP figures and typically run below list at retail. One draft entry ('Amazon Basics Standby UPS 800VA') was removed as unverifiable/likely fabricated. accessedAt 2026-08-16.

products.name: APC Back-UPS Pro BR1500MS2
products.priceNote: List/MSRP price (apcguard.com authorized reseller); typically discounted at retail.
products.provenance: Confirmed on apcguard.com this session: 1500VA/900W, pure sine wave output, 10-outlet layout (6 battery-backup+surge, 4 surge-only), dual USB-A/C smart charging, AVR, and $339.99 list price. Values unchanged from draft.

products.name: APC Back-UPS Pro BX1500M
products.priceNote: List price (apcguard.com authorized reseller); frequently discounted at retail.
products.provenance: Confirmed on apcguard.com this session: 1500VA/900W, 10-outlet layout (5 battery-backup+surge, 5 surge-only), AVR, USB for PC monitoring only (no device charging), $249.99 list price. BX-series outputs a stepped/simulated approximation on battery (not pure sine), so waveform is simulated_sine. Values unchanged from draft.

products.name: CyberPower CP1500PFCLCD PFC Sinewave UPS
products.provenance: Confirmed field-by-field on CyberPower's official product page this session: 1500VA/1000W, sine wave (pure), 12-outlet layout (6 battery-backup, 6 surge-only), 2 USB charging ports (1 Type-A + 1 Type-C), AVR (Single Boost), $274.95 MSRP. Values unchanged from draft.

products.name: CyberPower CP1500AVRLCD Intelligent LCD UPS
products.priceNote: Discontinued — no current MSRP published by manufacturer.
products.provenance: Confirmed on CyberPower's official product page this session: 1500VA/900W, simulated sine wave, 12 outlets (6 battery-backup, 6 surge-only), no USB charging, AVR. The page prominently flags this SKU as DISCONTINUED with no current MSRP, so priceUsd is null. Values unchanged from draft.

products.name: APC Back-UPS Pro BR1000MS
products.provenance: Confirmed on apcguard.com this session: 1000VA/600W, sine wave (pure), 10-outlet layout (6 battery-backup+surge, 4 surge-only), dual USB-A/C charging, Boost-and-Trim AVR, $209.99 list price. Values unchanged from draft.

products.name: Tripp Lite SmartPro SMART1500LCDT
products.priceNote: No confirmed manufacturer MSRP; the SKU is legacy (now retired under Eaton) and no reliable published list price could be confirmed.
products.provenance: Confirmed field-by-field against Eaton/Tripp Lite's official datasheet PDF this session: Output Capacity 1500VA/900W; Output Receptacles (10) 5-15R with 'UPS Output Receptacles (Surge Suppression Only): 5 UPS outlets, 5 surge-only outlets'; 'Output AC Waveform (Battery Mode): PWM sine wave' (a stepped/simulated approximation, so waveform is simulated_sine despite the 'Sine Wave' marketing name); Primary Form Factor Tower; Line-Interactive with AVR; USB is HID/monitoring only (not device charging). No manufacturer MSRP is published, so priceUsd is null. Values unchanged from draft; all now datasheet-verified.

products.name: Eaton 5S1500LCD
products.priceNote: No published USD price could be independently confirmed this session; distributor/retail figures cited in the draft (~$340–$400) could not be verified from any reachable source, so priceUsd is nulled rather than guessed.
products.provenance: Confirmed 1500VA/900W and line-interactive AVR via eatonguard.com this session; the model is real. However the exact battery/surge outlet split (draft claimed 5 battery + 5 surge) could not be corroborated — the eatonguard page reading conflicted with the draft — so battery_backup_outlets is nulled (total_outlets 10 retained per standard product documentation). The Cooper-Electric distributor price ($398.98) and the draft's Walmart figure ($339.82) could not be reached/verified (retailer pages blocked automated access), so priceUsd is nulled per 'null beats a guess.' Battery-mode waveform is not documented on the reachable pages, so waveform stays null.

products.name: CyberPower CP900AVR AVR Series UPS
products.provenance: Confirmed field-by-field on CyberPower's official product page this session: 900VA/560W, simulated sine wave, 10-outlet layout (5 battery-backup+surge, 5 surge-only), no USB charging, AVR (Single Boost), $164.95 MSRP. Values unchanged from draft (manufacturer's 560W used over Micro Center's 540W).

products.name: APC Back-UPS BE600M1
products.priceNote: List price (apcguard.com authorized reseller); Dell shows $112.37 street price for the same SKU.
products.provenance: Confirmed this session on Dell (600VA/330W, 'Stepped Approximated Sine Wave' → simulated_sine, 7-outlet layout with 5 battery-backup+surge and 2 surge-only, 1 USB charging port at 1.5A, price $112.37) and on apcguard.com ($99.99 list price, no AVR documented → avr false). priceUsd uses the $99.99 list figure; Dell's $112.37 is the street price. Values unchanged from draft.

products.name: CyberPower CP1350PFCLCD PFC Sinewave UPS
products.provenance: Confirmed field-by-field on CyberPower's official product page this session: 1350VA/880W, sine wave (pure), 12-outlet layout (6 battery-backup, 6 surge-only), 'USB Charge Port: No' (0 charging ports), AVR (Single Boost), $254.95 MSRP. Values unchanged from draft.

products.name: APC Smart-UPS SMT1500C
products.priceNote: List price (apcguard.com authorized reseller); street/retail pricing often runs lower.
products.provenance: Confirmed on apcguard.com this session: 1440VA actual (1500VA nameplate), pure sine wave on battery, 8 NEMA 5-15R outlets all battery-backed (hallmark of the Smart-UPS line), AVR, $789.00 list price. Output is 1000W per APC's Smart-UPS spec (some third-party retailer titles show 900W; the 1000W figure is retained and the discrepancy flagged). Values unchanged from draft.
